visualCharacteristics.purpose: One-at-a-time slider of text-media panels steered by a marker timeline
visualCharacteristics.layout: Ruled timeline with coloured ring markers and labels plus prev/next arrows; timeline above slides below 960px, below them from 960px
notable: Panels alternate media left (33/66) and right (66/33)
Marker colour per slide (aubergine, orange, green; default blue)
grey variant gives a grey slide band and timeline

contentPattern.structure: Each row has a label cell (heading plus optional marker colour word) and a panel cell (heading, picture, rich text, CTA links)
contentPattern.rows: One row per slide, two cells

usage: Use for a timeline or tabbed sequence of rich text-media panels
reuseGuidance: Fits several labelled panels each with heading, image and text; not for simple image carousels or single items
